'''Remove Another's Fatigue''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] in both the Control and Alter families of abilities. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to expel toxins from another's body, removing and counteracting the effects of fatigue.
